```{css, echo=FALSE}
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

body, .chart-title, .navbar, table {
  font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif !important;
}
body { background: #0F172A !important; color: #E2E8F0; }

/* ---------- Navbar ---------- */
.navbar {
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, #0B1220 0%, #134E4A 100%) !important;
  border: none !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
}
.navbar-brand, .navbar-nav > li > a { color: #F1F5F9 !important; font-weight: 600; }
.navbar-nav > li > a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12) !important; }

/* ---------- Animations ---------- */
@keyframes fadeUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
@keyframes popIn {
  0%   { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.85); }
  70%  { transform: scale(1.04); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}

/* ---------- Value boxes ---------- */
.value-box {
  border-radius: 16px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  animation: popIn 0.7s ease both;
  transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
}
.value-box:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(42, 157, 143, 0.35);
}
.value-box .value { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
.value-box .caption { opacity: 0.92; font-weight: 500; }

/* ---------- Chart cards ---------- */
.chart-wrapper {
  background: #1E293B;
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15) !important;
  border-radius: 16px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  animation: fadeUp 0.9s ease both;
  transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.chart-wrapper:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  border-color: rgba(42, 157, 143, 0.6) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(42, 157, 143, 0.25);
}
.chart-title {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1E293B, #26364D);
  color: #F1F5F9 !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-bottom: 3px solid #2A9D8F !important;
}

/* ---------- Tables ---------- */
table { border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; color: #E2E8F0 !important; }
table thead th { background: #0F766E; color: #ffffff; text-align: center; }
table tbody tr { background: #1E293B; }
table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #26364D; }
table tbody tr:hover { background: #2F4A5E; transition: background 0.2s; }
table td, table th { border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2) !important; }
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(knitr)
library(flexdashboard)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# ---- Load data (keep the .xlsx files in the same folder as this .Rmd) ----
households          <- read_excel("households.xlsx")
debt                <- read_excel("debt.xlsx")
education           <- read_excel("education.xlsx")
emergency_fund      <- read_excel("emergency_fund.xlsx")
financial_wellbeing <- read_excel("financial_wellbeing.xlsx")
food                <- read_excel("food.xlsx")
income              <- read_excel("income.xlsx")
savings             <- read_excel("savings.xlsx")
transport           <- read_excel("transport.xlsx")
utilities           <- read_excel("utilities.xlsx")

# ---- Join everything by household_id ----
Households_analysis <- households %>%
  left_join(debt, by = "household_id") %>%
  left_join(education, by = "household_id") %>%
  left_join(emergency_fund, by = "household_id") %>%
  left_join(financial_wellbeing, by = "household_id") %>%
  left_join(food, by = "household_id") %>%
  left_join(income, by = "household_id") %>%
  left_join(savings, by = "household_id") %>%
  left_join(transport, by = "household_id") %>%
  left_join(utilities, by = "household_id") %>%
  mutate(income_group = factor(income_group, levels = c("Low", "Middle", "High")))

# ---- Dark theme colors ----
txt_col  <- "#E2E8F0"   # main text
grid_col <- "rgba(148,163,184,0.18)"   # grid lines
card_col <- "#1E293B"   # card background

# ---- Shared palette and plot styling ----
pal <- c(Low = "#F26B4B", Middle = "#F5B83D", High = "#34C3B3")

style_plot <- function(p) {
  p %>%
    layout(paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
           plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
           font = list(family = "Poppins, sans-serif", color = txt_col),
           xaxis = list(gridcolor = grid_col, zerolinecolor = grid_col, linecolor = grid_col),
           yaxis = list(gridcolor = grid_col, zerolinecolor = grid_col, linecolor = grid_col),
           legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", y = -0.2,
                         font = list(color = txt_col))) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}
```

```{r count-up-js, results='asis'}
# Animates the value boxes: numbers count up when the dashboard loads
cat('
<script>
window.addEventListener("load", function () {
  function countUp(el) {
    var txt = el.textContent.trim();
    var m = txt.match(/^([^\\d-]*)([\\d,]*\\.?\\d+)(.*)$/);
    if (!m) return;
    var prefix = m[1], numStr = m[2], suffix = m[3];
    var decimals = (numStr.split(".")[1] || "").length;
    var hasComma = numStr.indexOf(",") > -1;
    var target = parseFloat(numStr.replace(/,/g, ""));
    var start = null, dur = 1500;
    function fmt(v) {
      var s = v.toFixed(decimals);
      if (hasComma) {
        var p = s.split(".");
        p[0] = p[0].replace(/\\B(?=(\\d{3})+(?!\\d))/g, ",");
        s = p.join(".");
      }
      return prefix + s + suffix;
    }
    function step(ts) {
      if (!start) start = ts;
      var p = Math.min((ts - start) / dur, 1);
      var e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
      el.textContent = fmt(target * e);
      if (p < 1) { requestAnimationFrame(step); } else { el.textContent = txt; }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  document.querySelectorAll(".value-box .value").forEach(countUp);
});
</script>
')
```

### Households by Income Group (Pie Chart)

```{r}
pie_data <- Households_analysis %>% count(income_group)

plot_ly(pie_data,
        labels = ~income_group, values = ~n, type = "pie",
        sort = FALSE, direction = "clockwise", rotation = 90,
        textinfo = "label+percent", textposition = "inside",
        insidetextfont = list(color = "#0F172A", size = 14),
        marker = list(colors = unname(pal[as.character(pie_data$income_group)]),
                      line = list(color = card_col, width = 3)),
        hovertemplate = "%{label}<br>%{value} households (%{percent})<extra></extra>") %>%
  layout(showlegend = FALSE) %>%
  style_plot()
```

### Monthly Income vs. Food Spending (press Play)

```{r}
groups <- levels(Households_analysis$income_group)
frame_labels <- c("1. Low income", "2. + Middle income", "3. + High income")

# Each frame reveals one more income group; hidden groups are set to NA
scatter_anim <- map_dfr(seq_along(groups), function(k) {
  Households_analysis %>%
    mutate(frame = factor(frame_labels[k], levels = frame_labels),
           x = ifelse(as.integer(income_group) <= k, monthly_income, NA_real_),
           y = ifelse(as.integer(income_group) <= k, food_spending, NA_real_))
})

plot_ly(scatter_anim, x = ~x, y = ~y, color = ~income_group, colors = pal,
        frame = ~frame, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(size = 10, opacity = 0.85, line = list(color = card_col, width = 1)),
        hovertemplate = "Income: %{x:,.0f}<br>Food: %{y:,.0f}<extra></extra>") %>%
  layout(margin = list(l = 70, r = 40, b = 110),
         xaxis = list(title = "Monthly Income", tickformat = ",", range = c(0, max(Households_analysis$monthly_income) * 1.05)),
         yaxis = list(title = "Food Spending", tickformat = ",", range = c(0, max(Households_analysis$food_spending) * 1.05))) %>%
  animation_opts(frame = 1200, transition = 600, redraw = FALSE) %>%
  animation_slider(x = 0.14, len = 0.72,
                   bgcolor = "#334155", activebgcolor = "#2A9D8F",
                   bordercolor = "#475569", tickcolor = "#94A3B8",
                   font = list(size = 11, color = txt_col),
                   currentvalue = list(prefix = "Showing: ", xanchor = "right",
                                       font = list(size = 13, color = txt_col))) %>%
  animation_button(label = "Play", x = 0, xanchor = "left", y = -0.05, yanchor = "top",
                   bgcolor = "#334155", bordercolor = "#475569",
                   font = list(color = txt_col)) %>%
  style_plot()
```

### Average Spending by Category (auto-plays)

```{r}
bar_base <- Households_analysis %>%
  summarise(Food = mean(food_spending, na.rm = TRUE),
            Transport = mean(transport_spending, na.rm = TRUE),
            Education = mean(education_spending, na.rm = TRUE),
            Training = mean(training_spending, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "category", values_to = "avg") %>%
  arrange(avg) %>%
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = category))

# Bars "grow" from 0 to their final value
bar_anim <- crossing(bar_base, step = seq(0, 1, length.out = 21)) %>%
  mutate(value = avg * step, frame = round(step * 100))

plot_ly(bar_anim, x = ~value, y = ~category, frame = ~frame,
        type = "bar", orientation = "h",
        marker = list(color = "#34C3B3"),
        hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{x:,.0f}<extra></extra>") %>%
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Average Spending", tickformat = ",",
                      range = c(0, max(bar_base$avg) * 1.1)),
         yaxis = list(title = "")) %>%
  animation_opts(frame = 60, transition = 0, redraw = TRUE) %>%
  animation_slider(hide = TRUE) %>%
  animation_button(label = "Replay", x = 1, xanchor = "right", y = 0, yanchor = "bottom",
                   bgcolor = "#334155", bordercolor = "#475569",
                   font = list(color = txt_col)) %>%
  style_plot() %>%
  onRender("function(el) {
    setTimeout(function() {
      Plotly.animate(el, null, {frame: {duration: 60, redraw: true},
                                transition: {duration: 0}, fromcurrent: false});
    }, 600);
  }")
```
